Convert a co-occurrence network to a Nestimate netobject

Source: R/converters.R
as_netobject.Rd

as_netobject() converts a co-occurrence network to a Nestimate netobject. Nestimate estimates and compares networks of several kinds (transition, partial correlation, co-occurrence) and stores them as netobjects, which its centrality and comparison functions accept; the conversion lets a co-occurrence network sit beside networks estimated there.

The netobject has method "cooccurrence" and is built from the weight matrix returned by as_matrix(), with the same node and edge tables as as_cograph() and the similarity, scale, threshold and number of transactions recorded as parameters. It is directed only for similarity = "relative".

The netobject carries no raw data (its data element is NULL), so Nestimate functions that resample the original observations, such as Nestimate::bootstrap_network(), cannot run on it. Build the network with Nestimate::cooccurrence() for those. For a result built with split_by, group names the network to convert.

Usage

as_netobject(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'cooccurrence'
as_netobject(x, group = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A cooccurrence edge list from cooccurrence().

...

Ignored.

group

For a result built with split_by, the name of the group to convert. NULL (default) for an unsplit result.

Value

A list of class c("netobject", "cograph_network") with method "cooccurrence", holding the weight matrix, a node table (one row per item), an edge table (one row per edge), directed, and the parameters used.

Conditions

cooccure_missing_package when Nestimate is not installed; the conditions of as_matrix() for group.

See also

as_cograph(); as_igraph(); as_matrix().

Examples

net <- cooccurrence(movies, field = "genres", sep = ",",
                    similarity = "jaccard", min_occur = 50)
if (requireNamespace("Nestimate", quietly = TRUE)) {
  Nestimate::net_centrality(as_netobject(net))
}
